name: calf-raise-donkey
title: Calf Raise (Donkey)
primer: This is an old school gym exercise which requires the assistance of another person.
steps: Bend at the waist and lean your arms against a weight rack or bench that is waist height.
Have a partner sit on top of your lower back.
Raise up on your toes leaning slightly forward.
Pause at the top and then lower your heels to the floor.
tips: This is an advanced exercise and not recommended for beginners.
Have a Personal Trainer or Instructor show you how to perform this exercise safely.
